$comment: Machine-readable mirror of docs/data/sources.md's Licence position / Status columns. This is what 01_fetch.sh actually reads to decide whether a real fetch may run — the prose document is the record of *why*, this file is what the pipeline checks before touching a network. The two must be kept in sync by hand: whenever a row in docs/data/sources.md changes status, update the matching entry here in the same change.
